prompt_text:
Task: General Text Translation

Write code that translates a list of strings while preserving order using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — DeepL:
  Service: DeepL API
  SDK: deepl
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: translate_text
  Setup hints: DEEPL_AUTH_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepl.com/docs/api-reference/translate

Option 2 — Google Cloud Translation:
  Service: Cloud Translation
  SDK: google-cloud-translate
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: translate_text, batch_translate_text
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs/overview

Option 3 — Azure AI Translator:
  Service: Azure AI Translator
  SDK: azure-ai-translation-text / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: translate
  Setup hints: AZURE_TRANSLATOR_KEY, AZURE_TRANSLATOR_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/translator/

Option 4 — Amazon Translate:
  Service: Amazon Translate
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: translate_text, translate_document
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 5 — Alibaba Machine Translation:
  Service: Machine Translation
  SDK: alibabacloud_alimt
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: TranslateGeneral, GetTranslateReport
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/machine-translation

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
```python
import os
from typing import List
import deepl

def translate_texts(texts: List[str], target_lang: str = "EN") -> List[str]:
    auth_key = os.getenv("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY")
    if not auth_key:
        raise ValueError("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY environment variable is required.")
    translator = deepl.Translator(auth_key)
    translated = []
    for text in texts:
        result = translator.translate_text(text, target_lang=target_lang)
        translated.append(result.text)
    return translated
```
